text: So, what kind of career are you interested in, Nam?
I'm not sure yet. I like science and technology, but I also enjoy working with people.
Have you considered a career in engineering or medicine?
I've thought about it. But I'm also interested in environmental science. I want to do something to help protect the planet.
That's a great field. There are many opportunities in renewable energy and conservation. You should research different careers and see what appeals to you most.
